nodes.rationale: Make spare-PC hosting accessible without Docker or Linux expertise.

nodes.label: Generic GameStack runtime
nodes.rationale: Shared installation, lifecycle, recovery and diagnostics keep game support maintainable.

nodes.label: Declarative GamePacks
nodes.rationale: Sell curated configuration, testing and guides rather than underlying game software.

nodes.label: Minecraft Paper: selected first GamePack
nodes.rationale: 2026-09-05 decision supersedes historical Foundry/Valheim-first research.

nodes.label: Open-core plus commercial GamePacks
nodes.rationale: Open engine supports trust and adoption; official packs provide commercial products.

nodes.label: Self-service support economics
nodes.rationale: A roughly $10 purchase cannot sustain an hour of personalized troubleshooting.

nodes.label: Simplicity over flexibility
nodes.rationale: Target ordinary gamers and keep maintenance burden low.

nodes.label: Conservative backup-first updates
nodes.rationale: Pinned, tested changes and recovery matter more than immediate updates.

nodes.label: Second real GamePack: not selected
nodes.rationale: Validate first pack before selecting and developing the second.

nodes.label: Future Connect and off-site Backup services
nodes.rationale: Require demonstrated demand before recurring hosted services.

nodes.label: Failure preserves recoverable data copies
nodes.rationale: Worlds and campaign data are irreplaceable; retain copies instead of destructive cleanup.

nodes.label: Validate-stop-snapshot-restore-start-health workflow
nodes.rationale: Stop writers and preserve current state before replacing saves.

nodes.label: Private persisted secrets and masked output
nodes.rationale: Never expose passwords, webhooks, tokens or licenses in logs or source control.

nodes.label: GamePack install/lifecycle/persistence/recovery acceptance
nodes.rationale: Schema validity alone does not establish support.

nodes.label: Install and prepare-only
nodes.rationale: Exclusive private creation preserves incomplete instances on failure.

nodes.label: Configured instance listing
nodes.rationale: Read-only state snapshots degrade to unknown with warnings when Docker is unavailable.

nodes.label: Confirmed instance removal
nodes.rationale: Remove containers, retain data/configuration/backups, and reserve the instance name.

nodes.label: Per-instance .operation.lock
nodes.rationale: Prevents overlapping operations; stale locks require confirmed inactivity.

nodes.label: Stopped-state manual backup
nodes.rationale: Stop writes, capture full data/configuration, verify archive, then resume an initially running server.

nodes.label: Private uncompressed .tar backup
nodes.rationale: Retain files, metadata and hashes; credentials may be present and archives are not encrypted.

nodes.label: Offline backup integrity verification
nodes.rationale: Read all members and verify hashes/structure without extraction; integrity is not authenticity or game acceptance.

nodes.label: Full-data restore
nodes.rationale: Verify and stage exact-pack backups, preserve current configuration, snapshot current data and retain previous folders.

nodes.label: .restore.json interruption marker
nodes.rationale: Intent phases block further mutation until folder state is manually reconciled.

nodes.label: Interrupted restore recovery
nodes.rationale: Stop writers, verify paths and archives, reconcile actual folder layout and retain every copy.

nodes.label: Start and restart health gate
nodes.rationale: A failed health wait may leave the container running; inspect state before retrying.

nodes.label: Docker and instance diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Checks prerequisites and configuration, not internet reachability or save consistency.

nodes.label: Side-effect-free nested command help
nodes.rationale: Help works without Docker or an installed instance.

nodes.label: GamePack schema 1
nodes.rationale: One container and data mount, digest-pinned image, prompt settings and executable healthcheck.

nodes.label: GamePack schema 2
nodes.rationale: Adds only concrete first-pack requirements while preserving schema-1 rendering.

nodes.label: Explicit HTTPS agreement acceptance
nodes.rationale: Default rejection; exact string TRUE before storage creation or downloads.

nodes.label: Persisted installing-user UID:GID
nodes.rationale: Run with original non-root identity; never silently recalculate ownership.

nodes.label: Explicit numeric bind address
nodes.rationale: Localhost default; all-interface exposure requires explicit choice and router rules remain manual.

nodes.label: Character-and-length input constraints
nodes.rationale: Avoid arbitrary pack-provided regular expressions.

nodes.label: Validated installation configuration snapshots
nodes.rationale: Reject edited generated Compose and retain instance paths across operations.

nodes.label: Non-runnable schema reference
nodes.rationale: Placeholder image and healthcheck prove only accepted structure.

nodes.label: Experimental Minecraft Paper GamePack
nodes.rationale: Selected first pack remains unsupported until remaining v0.1 gates pass.

nodes.label: Minecraft Java 26.2 / Paper build 121 / digest-pinned image
nodes.rationale: Prevent restart from silently selecting a newer image or game build.

nodes.label: Authenticated private allowlist
nodes.rationale: Online authentication and enforced whitelist restrict player access; existing access files survive restart.

nodes.label: TCP 25565 player port
nodes.rationale: Expose only Minecraft player connections; RCON, query, JMX and SSH disabled.

nodes.label: 4 GiB heap, eight players, survival normal defaults
Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS x86-64 acceptance target
nodes.rationale: Non-root Docker account, 8 GiB RAM and SSD are evaluation targets, not capacity guarantees.

nodes.label: Manual forwarding and external reachability
nodes.rationale: CGNAT, double NAT and ISP restrictions may block joins; no automated router changes.

nodes.label: All persistent Paper data under /data
nodes.rationale: Worlds, dimensions, player files, settings, downloaded artifacts and logs stay in one bind mount.

nodes.label: Playable milestone passed: user-confirmed 2026-09-06
nodes.rationale: All 12 manual criteria signed off; host outputs, timings and exact tested revision were not supplied.

nodes.label: Backup and restore scenario checklists pending
nodes.rationale: Manual command success does not establish each corruption/recovery scenario or full release acceptance.

nodes.label: Opt-in Paper Docker acceptance harness
nodes.rationale: Disposable host data and sanitized evidence; not default CI and cannot prove player-observed recovery.

nodes.label: Manual backup command passed: user-confirmed 2026-09-06
nodes.rationale: No detailed scenarios, host data or revision supplied.

nodes.label: Manual restore passed: user-confirmed 2026-09-06
nodes.rationale: Scenario-level evidence, retention, updates and final release gates remain separate.

nodes.label: Disposable crash, port, download, disk, permissions and health tests
nodes.rationale: Isolate fault injection from working servers and preserve evidence and partial data.

nodes.label: In-game earlier-world and safety-backup roundtrip
nodes.rationale: Verify placed structures/player state before and after selected and safety restores.

nodes.label: PyYAML >=6.0.2,<7 (MIT)
nodes.rationale: Only runtime dependency: standard library has no YAML parser.

nodes.label: Docker Engine and Compose host prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Externally installed and not redistributed by GameStack.

nodes.label: PyInstaller standalone bundling
nodes.rationale: Bootloader exception permits application bundles with appropriate interpreter/dependency notices.

nodes.label: External itzg / Paper / Temurin upstream stack
nodes.rationale: User pulls unmodified image and downloads game software; GameStack does not redistribute JARs or game assets.

nodes.label: Commercial branding and full artifact license review
nodes.rationale: Upstream source inventory is not complete transitive redistribution clearance.

nodes.label: Minecraft EULA and Usage Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Explicit agreement and legitimate Java accounts; descriptive branding and non-affiliation notice.

nodes.label: Deferred five-repository extraction
nodes.rationale: Two real packs must demonstrate a stable interface before separation; preserve instances and notices.

nodes.label: Explicit wheel, source and native pack inclusion
nodes.rationale: Wheel contains runtime; source/native include selected packs, never blindly bundle future directories.

nodes.label: v0.1 release gates
nodes.rationale: Playable success does not complete retention, verified recovery, explicit updates or clean-host release acceptance.

nodes.label: Backup retention: pending
nodes.rationale: All existing backups retained until safe pruning is implemented.

nodes.label: Safe explicit updates: pending
nodes.rationale: Require preflight, stopped-state backup, prior pins and failed-update recovery.

nodes.label: CI and release workflow
nodes.rationale: PR/push validation; only manual main runs publish after every required job succeeds.

nodes.label: Verified wheel/source/native artifact set
nodes.rationale: Build once, aggregate checksums, and publish exactly the checked assets.

nodes.label: Isolated release publishing job
nodes.rationale: Only publisher has contents write; no checkout, install or repository code execution there.

nodes.label: Manual-main annotated tag and draft-first publication
nodes.rationale: Existing releases block retries and conflicting tags are never moved.

nodes.label: Unsigned native bundles with bundled Python
nodes.rationale: Docker remains separate; Windows/macOS local tooling does not establish hosting support.

nodes.label: Synthetic nginx Docker acceptance
nodes.rationale: Tests orchestration and retained synthetic data, not real-game save consistency.

nodes.label: Weekly Actions and monthly pip build-tool updates
nodes.rationale: Review pins and CI before merging; limit open PRs to five Actions and three pip updates.
